prompt:
Create a production game sprite kit, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 separate objects in equal square cells on a truly transparent background, generous empty margins per cell, no labels or grid lines. Detailed hand-painted dark fantasy isometric 2:1 game art, orthographic camera, consistent upper-left neutral illumination. Material: aged pale limestone gothic cathedral, restrained tarnished gold, weathered buttress courses, no bright glow. All objects belong to one modular connected architectural kit. Straight modules have the same length and cross section. Long direction slopes exactly 1 vertical for 2 horizontal pixels. Render complete objects uncropped.
Row 1: a straight wall running from upper left to lower right; same wall running from upper right to lower left; alternate damaged first wall; alternate damaged second wall.
Row 2: a concave L-shaped wall corner; a convex L-shaped wall corner; short capped end wall facing lower right; short capped end wall facing lower left.
Row 3: low broken first-direction wall; low broken second-direction wall; first-direction wall end with square door jamb; second-direction wall end with square door jamb.
Row 4: DEEP vertical foundation face running from upper left to lower right, with only a very thin top lip and jagged rocky bottom; matching foundation face from upper right to lower left; deep foundation outer corner with two faces; heavy bridge abutment with descending fractured rock.
The bottom-row foundations are substantial solid masses extending downward, NOT floating thin slabs. Top three rows have clear consistent floor contact lines, flat joining ends and narrow bases. No floor diamonds, no cast shadow outside objects, no glow, no scenery, no text. Keep camera, painting and stone detail consistent with supplied cathedral reference.
